regions.finding: The prose applies the Curtin-Hammett interpretation, identifies (Ra)-TS-2a/7.88 kcal/mol as the favored substitution path, and introduces the proposed 1,5-oxidative-addition/eta3-shift/conjugate-substitution cycle. Scheme 6 is a mechanism rather than an experiment.

regions.finding: The image shows the proposed catalytic cycle: Pd catalyst generation, 1,5-oxidative addition of 1h, contra-thermodynamic eta3 shift, Cu/2c/Cs2CO3 nucleophile generation, and conjugate substitution to (Ra,S)-3hc. Proposed intermediates are not isolated preparations.

rac-9 (1.0 equiv) and 2a (1.0 equiv) under Pd/(R)-L1 and Cu/(S,Sp)-L3 give (Ra,S)-3ha in 52% with >20:1 rr, >99% ee, >20:1 dr, while rac-9 is recovered in 41% with 0% ee. Product yield and substrate recovery remain separate targeted outcomes.
Enantiopure (Ra)-9 (>99% ee) with 5 mol% 2a under the same catalyst labels is recovered in 93% yield and >99% ee. This is a separate recovery-only control and no product yield is invented.
